tickets.subject: Charged twice for October
tickets.text: Hi! I see two charges of $49 on the same day (Oct 3) for the Pro plan. I only have one subscription. Please refund the extra one.

tickets.subject: Dashboard stuck on loading
tickets.text: The dashboard has been spinning for ten minutes. Other pages open fine. I tried another browser, same thing. This is blocking my team.

tickets.subject: Can't log in after email change
tickets.text: I changed my work email last week and now the login says the account does not exist. The old address is gone, I cannot receive the reset link.

tickets.subject: API returns 429 after 100 requests
tickets.text: We are on Enterprise and our export job gets 429 after roughly a hundred calls. The docs say the limit is 1000/min. Has something changed?

tickets.subject: Please add dark mode
tickets.text: Any chance of a dark theme? Half my team works at night and the white background is rough.

tickets.subject: This is the third week without an answer
tickets.text: I have written three times about the failed migration and nobody replied. We are paying for Enterprise support. If this is not resolved today we are cancelling.

tickets.subject: How do I export to CSV?
tickets.text: Is there a way to get a report as CSV? I only see the PDF button.
